errors.text_span: The bar chart features three groups of bars, each representing one of the methods
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart with five groups, one for each category on the x-axis (Accounting, Certificate, etc.). Each group contains three bars, one for each method. The description incorrectly states there are three groups, one for each method.

errors.text_span: For Accounting, the approximate values are A-DBSCAN at 65, Random at 65, and K-Center-Greedy at 65.
errors.evidence: The bars for the Accounting category are not all equal in value. The approximate values are A-DBSCAN at 67, Random at 66, and K-Center-Greedy at 68.

errors.text_span: For Economy, the values are A-DBSCAN at 65, Random at 65, and K-Center-Greedy at 65.
errors.evidence: The bars for the Economy category are not all equal in value. The approximate values are A-DBSCAN at 63, Random at 64, and K-Center-Greedy at 65.

errors.text_span: For Finance, the values are A-DBSCAN at 65, Random at 65, and K-Center-Greedy at 65.
errors.evidence: The bars for the Finance category are not all equal in value. The A-DBSCAN bar is visibly taller (approx. 68) than the Random and K-Center-Greedy bars (approx. 64).

errors.text_span: For AVG, the values are A-DBSCAN at 70, Random at 70, and K-Center-Greedy at 70.
errors.evidence: The bars for the AVG category are not all equal in value, although they are close. The approximate values are A-DBSCAN at 68, Random at 68, and K-Center-Greedy at 68. Stating they are all 70 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: with each method's bars grouped together for easy comparison across categories
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes the chart's structure. The bars are grouped by category (Accounting, Certificate, etc.), not by method.
